title: Use Multiple Chat AI at Once - Chrome Web Store
excerpt: Just use multiple chat AI at once to find which model is best for your task! It's an all in one AI solution to compare ai chatbots.
content_html:
Overview

Just use multiple chat AI at once to find which model is best for your task! It's an all in one AI solution to compare ai chatbots.

🚀 One prompt → many answers ✴️ Write your prompt once — send it to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more services in a single click. Use multiple chat AI at once from one Composer. ✴️ Compare LLM outputs in an AI side-by-side view of tiled windows or in grouped tabs — and decide which model is best without switching between a dozen browser tabs. ✴️ Save any prompt as a template. Search, reuse, export/import — build a personal library of multiple prompts that work so you never rewrite from scratch. ✴️ No API keys, no sign-up. This AI chatbot extension works with your existing logged-in sessions — install and go. ✴️ Keyboard-first: open (Ctrl+Shift+1 / ⌘+⇧+1 by default), save (Ctrl+S / ⌘+S), send (Ctrl+Enter / ⌘+Enter) — chat with models without touching the mouse. 🔧 How it works 1. Press Ctrl+Shift+1 / ⌘+⇧+1 (the default shortcut) — the extension window opens. 2. Write a prompt or load a saved template in Composer. 3. Tick the chats under "Send to" to chat with models you need — one click per chat. 4. Choose how answer tabs are arranged — left where they are, grouped tabs in one window, or a window each in multiple tiled windows (the first 6; the rest open as tabs) — to compare LLM outputs side by side. 5. Press Ctrl+Enter / ⌘+Enter — send your prompt to multiple chat services at once. 6. Review results and decide which model is best for your task. 7. Save the prompt as a template — search, export, or import across your all in one ChatGPT and all in one GPT chatbot hub. ⚡ Why do you need this? If you chat with models across tabs, you know the pain: 💠 You copy-paste the same prompt between tabs — there's no way to use multiple chat AI at once. 💠 You send the wrong prompt version and notice too late. 💠 You lose time hunting through all AI chats in dozens of tabs. 💠 You want to compare LLMs, but real AI side-by-side comparison is impossible with constant switching. 💠 You forget your best prompts because saving is hard. 💠 You test which model is best, but it forces the same multiple chat routine again and again. 💠 This workflow doesn't scale without an AI chat aggregator. Fix it — use multiple chat AI at once: ✅ Write once → send to all AI bots you pick in one click: a true all-in-one AI flow. ✅ Same text to multiple AI services — no copy-paste mistakes. ✅ Compare LLM results in an AI side-by-side view of tiled windows on the monitor you pick, or in grouped tabs. ✅ Save prompts as templates and find them fast (search / date / usage). ✅ No API keys, no server in between — an AI Chrome extension using your chat sessions. ✅ One chatbot hub for all supported AI chats — tick a checkbox to add one more to the send. 👤 Who it's for Anyone who asks AI the same question more than once — at work or for study. Typical tasks: 🔹 Send one coding prompt to multiple models — compare solutions before implementing. 🔹 Validate PRDs across models — compare risks and acceptance criteria at once. 🔹 Generate campaign angles, copy, and outlines in parallel — pick the strongest. 🔹 Cross-check queries and interpretations across models to reduce blind spots. 🔹 Compare positioning, pricing, and risk takes from multiple models — validate ideas faster. 🔹 Cross-check test cases across models, save best prompts as reusable templates. 🔹 Get parallel UI critiques and microcopy variants — pick the clearest direction. 🔹 Produce multiple drafts at once, reuse consistent structure via templates. 🔹 Draft reply variants in parallel, reuse proven responses with saved templates. 🔹 Generate multiple job descriptions, interview questions, or translations — compare tone and quality. 🔒 Privacy & security 🔶 No content collection. No data selling. 🔶 Local-first storage. Multiple chat prompts and templates stay in your browser and go only to the AI chats you pick. 🔶 Our pages count installs, ratings and uninstalls, and how long an installation lasted — only when the extension itself opens them. Your multiple chat activity is never collected. 🔶 No middleman. When you chat with models, prompts go directly into vendor pages in your tabs — no proxy, no third-party API. 🔶 Prompts stay private. Templates, drafts, and all in one ChatGPT workflows live in your local profile. Uninstall — local data is gone. 🔶 Offline export only. Template JSON and CSV files save to your device. Templates never sync to the cloud. 🔶 Transparent permissions. All sites: chats, the on-page button, the page menu and reading pages you attach. Clipboard reading is opt-in. You decide what to share and which model is best to trust with it. 🔶 Self-auditable. Inspect stored data via DevTools. Our policy lists all we count — nothing about your chats is ever sent to us, even while you compare LLM outputs across all in one GPT services.
